div.p: A generic Odoo 19 Community tenant showing how a pharma distributor keeps tax, cash and partner stock under control: no rate is ever assumed, nothing is adjusted without evidence, and every change has a maker and a checker.

ul.li: Add a product to the cart: one of them has no approved tax classification and cannot be confirmed.
Sign in and open Pharma › Tax Centre: rules in draft, approved, superseded; a DEMO rule refused in production mode.
Pharma › Reconciliation: a clean match, a short COD settlement, an unidentified bank credit, an ambiguous amount.
Distribution Partner: stock roll-forward variances and a commercial model still awaiting sign-off.

div.p: Effective-dated, approved-only tax rules. A sale or invoice line with an unresolved treatment is blocked at confirmation, not fixed later. Every posted tax event is immutable and corrected only by a reversal.
Scenarios: approved · pending evidence · draft awaiting approver · evidence missing · overlapping rules (ambiguous) · superseded · reversal.

COD courier batches, gateway payouts and bank lines matched by exact reference first, then by batch, then by amount and date flagged low confidence. Variances become exceptions with an owner, a note and a second approver. Nothing is written off automatically.
Scenarios: clean batch · short settlement · unidentified credit · reference with amount difference · ambiguous amount · low-confidence match.

A stock roll-forward per SKU and lot: opening, inward, issued, returned, expired, reported. Each variance raises an exception. Custody is always recorded; revenue and tax follow only an approved commercial model with contract and sign-offs.
Scenarios: zero variance · shortfall · surplus · scenario gate blocked awaiting sign-off.

This is a staging demonstration. The company, customers, products, prices, tax rates, bank lines and partner stock are all fictional and marked DEMO. The database is neutralized: no e-mail is sent and no payment provider is active, so the checkout stops at the payment step by design.
Built on Odoo 19 Community by C2P Consultants. Standard configuration first, native automation second, custom code last.
